hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Every element of nums1 had the same integer x added to produce nums2.

hints.title: Order Preserving Property
hints.text: Adding a constant to all elements preserves their relative order, meaning the minimum element of nums1 maps to the minimum element of nums2.

hints.title: Direct Computation
hints.text: Compute min(nums2) - min(nums1) and return the difference.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of arrays nums1 and nums2
complexity.notes: Single pass finding minima of both arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting both arrays takes O(n log n) time when a linear scan suffices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that comparing the minima of both arrays immediately yields the added integer.
